statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9)
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) was ordered
The diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) was submitted
The claim was denied with reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that care may be covered by another payer in accordance with coordination of benefits protocols
